sheet_log.title: EXTERIOR ELEVATIONS - OPTION 01
sheet_log.notes: Drawing A-201 shows four overall exterior elevations (North, South, East, West) of an industrial tilt-up concrete building for Crow Holdings Industrial on Cass White Road, Bartow County, Georgia. Scales range from 1"=39'-0" to 1"=40'-0". Key elevation heights shown: TI Panel at Entry = 40'-2", TI Panel = 42'-2", Finish Floor = 0'-1", Truck Court = 0'-0". Due to small image resolution, exact counts of dock doors, man doors, overhead doors, wall packs, louvers, and other components could not be definitively counted; marked as null. Exterior finish system uses three Pittsburgh Paints painted concrete finishes (101, 102, 103) with colors TBD per color legend. Glass schedule includes three types (A, B, C) all insulated with Low-E coatings and U=0.28. Canopy elements appear at office entry areas. Sheet is marked 'NOT ISSUED FOR CONSTRUCTION' and is at 95% design review stage per revision block.

sheet_log.title: MISC. DETAILS
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A-401 is a miscellaneous details sheet for an industrial building (Crow Holdings - Cass White Road, Bartow County, Georgia). It contains 13 detail callouts covering bollards, ramps, stairs, dock levelers (future), guardrails, handrails, fire riser/electrical panel protection, and pump/electrical room section. No quantity takeoff legend or schedule tables are present. Most quantities are not directly countable from this detail sheet alone; quantities must be tallied from plan sheets. Dock leveler details (Details 1, 2, 3) are designated FUTURE. All stair railings are noted to be galvanized. All pipe noted as EXTRA STRONG. Scales per detail: Detail 1 = 1/2"=1'-0", Detail 2 = 1/2"=1'-0", Detail 3 = 1/2"=1'-0", Detail 4 = 3/4"=1'-0", Detail 5 = 3/4"=1'-0", Detail 6 = 1/2"=1'-0", Detail 7 = 3/4"=1'-0", Detail 8 = 1 1/2"=1'-0", Detail 9 = 3/4"=1'-0", Detail 10 = 1/2"=1'-0", Detail 11 = 1/2"=1'-0", Detail 12 = 1/4"=1'-0", Detail 13 = 3/4"=1'-0". Sheet marked NOT ISSUED FOR CONSTRUCTION.
